name: v9_adapt
note: Adaptive animal-mix family (V9 = V8 + demand-driven sheep flock). The baseline opponent is V7; BASE_agent_v9_adapt is V9 with the default policy (adaptive d8/y2/h9). Variants sweep decision day, yarn trigger, high-flock size, and add static 7/8-sheep controls (their own base files in sweeps/_bases) to test whether ANY non-6 flock beats the fixed mix. Promote only if a variant clears the 250-seed Wilson gate AND wins the Bradley-Terry finals; otherwise V8 stays champion. NOTE: V9 is the candidate here, so run the finals round-robin is among V9 variants; to compare against V8 directly include it as a variant with an empty params block (see v8_control).
